helper_statement:
theorem constantsAreBase {K F : Type*} [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [IsCurveOver K F]
    (hfg : ∃ x : F, Transcendental K x ∧
      FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin K ({x} : Set F)) F) :
    ConstantsAreBase K F
assumptions: Field K, Field F, Algebra K F, IsAlgClosed K, IsCurveOver K F and original transcendental finite-extension existence hypothesis; no CharZero hypothesis
